_readme: Official South African public-school term dates (DBE national calendar),
packaged server-side for rlms.term_report_rules — the Term Report's term
boundaries. Same packaged-data posture as known_schools.json: verbatim
official dates, never hand-adjusted or fabricated. All nine provinces
follow one unified national calendar since 2024, so there is no
inland/coastal split to model. Years absent from this file degrade to
the calendar-quarter approximation board_coverage.py already uses
(flagged approximate in the API answer) — add each new gazetted year
here as the DBE publishes it.

_source.name: DBE 2026 school calendar for public schools
notes: Dates below are LEARNER dates. The gazette summary table prints
educator-only dates in parentheses: Term 1 '(12) 14 January - 27 March'
(educators report 12 Jan) and Term 4 '06 October - 09 (11) December'
(educators close 11 Dec). Learners: 14 Jan open, 09 Dec close.
